extDescription.message: Bulk-delete X (Twitter) DMs: tick messages or whole chats and delete them in one go. Runs locally; no data leaves your device.

popupStep2.message: The bulk-delete panel appears at the top right

popupStep3.message: Choose conversations or messages, tick them, then click Delete

popupNote.message: Deletion works by clicking X’s own menus in your browser; no message content is read or uploaded. Not an official X product and not affiliated with X Corp.
